ja524:1.1: Ariyāvakāso si pasannanetto maññe bhavaṃ pabbajito kulamhā, kathan nu vittāni pahāya bhoge pabbaji nikkhamma gharā sapaññā 'ti.
ja524:2.1: Sayaṃ vimānaṃ naradeva disvā mahānubhāvassa mahoragassa disvāna puññānaṃ mahāvipākaṃ saddhāyāhaṃ pabbajito 'mhi rāja.
ja524:3.1: Na kāmakāmā na bhayā na dosā vācaṃ musā pabbajitā bhaṇanti, akkhāhi me pucchito etam atthaṃ, sutvāna me jāyihiti-ppasādo.
ja524:4.1: Vaṇijja raṭṭhādhipa gacchamāno pathe addasāsim hi milācaputte pavaṭṭakāyaṃ uragaṃ mahantaṃ ādāya gacchante pamodamāne.
ja524:5.1: So 'haṃ samāgamma janinda tehi saṃhaṭṭhalomo avacasmi bhīto: kuhiṃ ayaṃ nīyati bhīmakāyo, nāgena kiṃ kāhathā bhojaputtā.
ja524:6.1: Nāgo ayaṃ nīyati bhojanatthaṃ pavaṭṭakāyo urago mahanto, sāduñ ca thūlañ ca muduñ ca maṃsaṃ na tvaṃ ras' {aññāsi} Videhaputta.
ja524:7.1: Ito mayaṃ gantvā sakaṃ niketanaṃ ādāya satthāni vikopayitvā maṃsaṃ thokkhāma pamodamānā, mayaṃ hi vo sattavo pannagānaṃ.
ja524:8.1: Sace ayaṃ nīyati bhojanatthaṃ pavaṭṭakāyo urago mahanto dadāmi vo balivaddāni soḷasa, nāgaṃ imaṃ muñcatha bandhanasmā.
ja524:9.1: Addhā hi no bhakkho ayaṃ manāpo bahū ca no uragā bhuttapubbā, karoma te taṃ vacanaṃ Aḷāra, mittañ ca no hohi Videhaputta.
ja524:10.1: Tad assu te bandhanā mocayiṃsu yaṃ natthuto paṭimokkh' assa pāse, mutto ca so bandhanā nāgarājā pakkāmi pācīnamukho muhuttaṃ.
ja524:11.1: Gantvāna pācīnamukho muhuttaṃ puṇṇehi nettehi palokayī maṃ, tad ass' ahaṃ piṭṭhito anvagañchiṃ dasaṅguliṃ añjaliṃ paggahetvā.
ja524:12.1: Gacch' eva kho tvaṃ taramānarūpo, mā taṃ amittā punar aggahesuṃ, dukkho hi luddehi punā samāgamo, adassanaṃ bhojaputtāna gaccha.
ja524:13.1: Agamāsi so rahadaṃ vippasannaṃ nīlobhāsaṃ ramaṇīyaṃ sutitthaṃ samotataṃ jambuhi vetasāhi, pāvekkhi niṭṭiṇṇabhayo paṭīto.
ja524:14.1: So taṃ pavissa nacirassa nāgo dibbena me pātur ahū janinda, upaṭṭhahī maṃ pitaraṃ va putto hadayaṅgamaṃ kaṇṇasukhaṃ bhaṇanto.
ja524:15.1: Tvaṃ me si mātā ca pitā ca Aḷāra abbhantaro pāṇadado sahāyo, sakañ ca iddhiṃ paṭilābhito smi, Aḷāra passa me nivesanāni pahūtabhakkhaṃ bahuannapānaṃ Masakkasāraṃ viya Vāsavassā
ja524:16.1: 'ti. Taṃ bhūmibhāgehi upetarūpaṃ, asakkharā c' eva mudū subhā ca nīcātiṇā apparajā ca bhūmi pāsādikā yattha jahanti sokaṃ
ja524:17.1: Anāvakulā veḷuriyūpanīlā, catuddisaṃ ambavanaṃ surammaṃ, pakkā ca pesī ca phalā suphullā, niccotukā dhārayantī phalānīti.
ja524:18.1: Tesaṃ vanānaṃ naradeva majjhe nivesanaṃ bhassarasannikāsaṃ rajataggaḷaṃ sovaṇṇamayaṃ uḷāraṃ obhāsatī vijjur iv' antalikkhe
ja524:19.1: Maṇimayā sovaṇṇamayā uḷārā anekacittā satataṃ sunimmitā paripūra kaññāhi alaṃkatāhi suvaṇṇakāyūradharāhi rāja.
ja524:20.1: So Saṃkhapālo taramānarūpo pāsādam āruyha anomavaṇṇo sahassathambhaṃ atulānubhāvaṃ yatth' assa bhariyā mahesī ahosi.
ja524:21.1: Ekā ca nārī taramānarūpā ādāya veḷuriyamayaṃ mahagghaṃ subhaṃ maṇiṃ jātimantūpapannaṃ acoditā āsanam abbhihāsi.
ja524:22.1: Tato maṃ urago hatthe gahetvā nisīdayī pamukhamāsanasmiṃ: idam āsanaṃ atrabhavaṃ nisīdatu, bhavaṃ hi me aññataro garūnaṃ.
ja524:23.1: Aññā ca nārī taramānarūpā ādāya vāriṃ upasaṃkamitvā pādāni pakkhālayi me janinda bhariyā ca bhattū patino piyassa.
ja524:24.1: Aparā ca nārī taramānarūpā paggayha sovaṇṇamayā pātiyā anekasūpaṃ vividhaṃ viyañjanaṃ upanāmayī bhatta manuññarūpaṃ.
ja524:25.1: Turiyehi maṃ Bhārata bhuttavantaṃ upaṭṭhahuṃ bhattu mano viditvā tatuttariṃ maṃ nipati mahantaṃ dibbehi kāmehi anappakehīti.
ja524:26.1: Bhariyā mam' etā tisatā Aḷāra sabb' atthamajjhā padumuttarābhā, Aḷāra etā su te kāmakāro dadāmi te tā paricārayassū 'ti gātham āha.
ja524:27.1: Saṃvaccharaṃ dibbaras' ānubhutvā tadass' ahaṃ uttariṃ paccabhāsiṃ: nāgass' idaṃ kinti kathañ ca laddhaṃ kath' ajjhagamāsi vimānaseṭṭhaṃ.
ja524:28.1: Adhicca laddhaṃ pariṇāmajan te sayaṃkataṃ udāhu devehi dinnaṃ, pucchāmi te nāgarāja tam atthaṃ, kath' ajjhagamāsi vimānaseṭṭhan ti.
ja524:29.1: Nādhicca laddhaṃ na pariṇāmajam me na sayaṃkataṃ na pi devehi dinnaṃ, sakehi kammehi apāpakehi puññehi me laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ.
ja524:30.1: Kin te vataṃ kiṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ kissa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko, akkhāhi me nāgarāje tam atthaṃ: kathan nu te laddhaṃ idaṃ vimānaṃ.
ja524:31.1: Rājā ahosiṃ Magadhānam issaro Duyyodhano nāma mahānubhāvo, so ittaraṃ jīvitaṃ saṃviditvā asassataṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ
ja524:32.1: Annañ ca pānañ ca pasannacitto sakkacca dānaṃ vipulaṃ adāsi, opānabhūtaṃ me gharaṃ tadāsi, santappitā samaṇabrāhmaṇā ca.
ja524:34.1: Tam me vataṃ taṃ pana brahmacariyaṃ tassa suciṇṇassa ayaṃ vipāko, ten' eva me laddham idaṃ vimānaṃ pahūtabhakkhaṃ bahuannapānaṃ Naccehi gītehi upetarūpaṃ ciraṭṭhitikaṃ, na ca sassat'āyaṃ,
ja524:35.1: appānubhāvā taṃ mahānubhāvaṃ tejassinaṃ hanti atejavanto, kim eva dāṭhāvudha kiṃ paṭicca hatthattham āgañchi vanibbakānaṃ.
ja524:36.1: Bhayan nu te anvagataṃ mahantaṃ tejo nu te nānvagaṃ dantamūlam, kim eva dāṭhāvudha kiṃ paṭicca kilesam āpajji vanibbakānaṃ.
ja524:37.1: Na me bhayaṃ anvagataṃ mahantaṃ tejo na sakkā mama tehi hantuṃ, satañ ca dhammāni sukittitāni samuddavelā va duraccayāni.
ja524:38.1: Cātuddasiṃ pannarasiñ c' Aḷāra uposathaṃ niccam upāvasāmi, athāgamuṃ soḷasa bhojaputtā rajjuṃ gahetvāna daḷhañ ca pāsaṃ.
ja524:39.1: Bhetvāna nāsaṃ atikassa rajjuṃ nayiṃsu maṃ sampaṭiggayha luddā, etādisaṃ dukkham ahan titikkhiṃ uposathaṃ appaṭikopayanto.
ja524:40.1: Ekāyane taṃ pathe addasāsiṃ balena vaṇṇena upetarūpaṃ, siriyā ca paññāya ca bhāvito si, kimatthiyaṃ nāga tapo karosi.
ja524:41.1: Na puttahetu na dhanassa hetu (= IV 466|11) na āyuno cāpi Aḷāra hetu, manussayoniṃ abhipatthayāno tasmā parakkamma tato karomi.
ja524:42.1: Tvaṃ lohitakkho vihatantaraṃso alaṃkato kappitakesamassu surosito lohitacandanena gandhabbarājā va disā pabhāsasi.
ja524:43.1: Deviddhipatto si mahānubhāvo sabbehi kāmehi samaṅgibhūto, pucchāmi taṃ nāgarāje tam atthaṃ: seyyo ito kena manussaloko.
ja524:44.1: Aḷāra nāññatra manussalokā suddhī ca saṃvijjati saññamo vā, ahañ ca laddhāna manussayoniṃ kāhāmi jātīmaraṇassa antaṃ.
ja524:45.1: Saṃvaccharo me vusito tav' antike, annena pānena upaṭṭhito 'smi, āmantayitvāna palemi nāga, cirappavuttho 'smi ahaṃ janinda.
ja524:46.1: Puttā ca dārā c' anujīvino ca niccānusiṭṭhā upatiṭṭhate taṃ, kaccin nu te nābhisaṃsittha koci, piyaṃ hi me dassanaṃ tuyh' Aḷāra.
ja524:47.1: Yathā ca mātā ca pitā c' agāre putto piyo paṭivihito va seyyo tato pi mayhaṃ idha-m-eva seyyo cittaṃ hi te nāga mayī pasannaṃ.
ja524:48.1: Maṇī mama vijjati lohitaṃko dhanāhāro maṇiratanaṃ uḷāraṃ, ādāya taṃ gaccha sakaṃ niketaṃ laddhā dhanaṃ taṃ maṇim ussajassū 'ti.
ja524:49.1: Diṭṭhā mayā mānusikāpi kāmā asassatā vipariṇāmadhammā, ādīnavaṃ kāmaguṇesu disvā saddhāy' ahaṃ pabbajito 'mhi rāja.
ja524:50.1: Dumapphalān' eva patanti mānavā daharā ca vuddhā ca sarīrabhedā, etam pi disvā pabbajito 'mhi rāja apaṇṇakaṃ sāmaññam eva seyyo.
ja524:51.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino, nāgañ ca sutvāna tavañ c' Aḷāra karomi puññāni anappakānīti.
ja524:52.1: Addhā have sevitabbā sapaññā bahussutā ye bahuṭhānacintino, nāgañ ca sutvāna mamañ ca rāja karohi puññāni anappakānīti.
